title: 1D Kalman filter update
prompt: Implement `kalman_update(x, P, z, R)` for scalar state: compute Kalman gain, updated mean and variance. Return (x_new, P_new).
public_tests_hint:
- with tiny R, x moves toward z
- P decreases
test_source: import solution def run(): x,P=0.0,1.0 xn,Pn=solution.kalman_update(x,P,10.0,0.01) assert xn>5 and Pn
